title: My Living Room
text:
This is my living room. It is big and bright. There is a blue sofa next to the window, and a small table in the middle of the room.

On the table there is a lamp and a book. My family likes to sit here in the evening. We watch TV and talk together.

questions.text: Why does the family probably like the living room?
options: It is a comfortable place to spend time together

questions.text: What time of day do they usually spend time in the living room?

vocabulary.definition: a long soft seat for two or more people
a light that you can put on a table or stand
